name: Outlet Missouri River
places: Spanish Lake Fire Protection District Station 1
Black Jack Fire Protection District Station 2
Edward "ted" And Pat Jones-confluence Point State Park
about: Outlet Missouri River drains about 54 square miles, 58% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 660 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 400 feet at its lowest. Its main stream is Mill Creek. It includes part of West Alton. This is where the Missouri River joins the Mississippi River.
